# Noto Serif ExtraLight

Source: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/8b0a1d0f5983c89bc2b93f1b5fb55f9e252744b5/ofl/notoserif

SIL OFL 1.1; see noto-serif-OFL.txt. Static weight 200, width 100.

European Latin (including accents), Greek, Cyrillic, combining marks and punctuation. No layout features; SVG and PDF share the same advances. PDF uses a Unicode character map and the same TrueType outlines as the local web font.

Original TTF SHA-256: 4d8e6761424656867019081a1a01336f3cb086982682698714054fc33f782713
